candidates.description: These tokens represent forms and conjugations of the French auxiliary and copular verbs "être" (to be) and "avoir" (to have).
This vector represents units of time and calendar periods across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates on various punctuation mark combinations typically used to close sentences or clauses with quotation marks and parentheses.
This vector represents French first- and second-person pronouns along with words containing similar root patterns and capitalization variants.
This feature vector activates on words, roots, or fragments related to flowers, botany, and botanical ornamentation.
This vector is related to capitalized prefixes, roots, and proper nouns involving geographic, religious, or historical terms.
This vector activates on common French words and grammatical markers.
These tokens represent common French adverbial modifiers of time, frequency, manner, and logical progression.
This feature vector activates strongly on words and subwords containing the character sequence "temp" or related to temples and time.
This vector activates on common punctuation marks, quotation symbols, and dashes used in text formatting.
